# Provider icons

`Resources/Assets.xcassets/GPTMark.imageset/gpt-mark.svg` uses the OpenAI
Blossom mark distributed by Lobe Icons under the accompanying MIT license:
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/blob/master/packages/static-svg/icons/openai.svg

The asset retains the original vector path; dimensions and fill are set for
native template rendering. The OpenAI/ChatGPT marks belong to OpenAI:
https://openai.com/brand/

`Resources/Assets.xcassets/ClaudeMark.imageset/claude-mark.svg` uses the Claude
mark distributed by Lobe Icons under the same accompanying MIT license:
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/blob/master/src/Claude/components/Mono.tsx

The asset retains the original vector path; dimensions and fill are set for
native template rendering. The Claude mark belongs to Anthropic.
